title: Supported quasi-coherent property contains the zero object
statement: theorem supported_qcoh_containsZero (X : Scheme.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] (T : Set X) : (supportedProperty X T).ContainsZero

source.place: Tag 0A9A, definition of supported subcategory preceding lemma

proof.text: Construct the free module sheaf on PEmpty and show its identity is zero using freeHomEquiv. It is quasi-coherent by isQuasicoherent_free, so the quasi-coherent object property contains a zero object. Every homology of the zero derived object is zero because homologyFunctor is additive; transport quasi-coherence with prop_of_isZero.

The composite from module sheaves to additive sheaves to additive presheaves to the stalk at x is additive. It sends each zero homology sheaf to a zero additive group. AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero establishes the required stalk subsingleton for every x, hence for every x outside T.
